newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Orient Overseas appoints director.
newsitem.headline: Orient Overseas appoints director.

text.p: Shipping group Orient Overseas (International) Ltd said on Wednesday it had appointed Robert Suan as a director of the company with effect from May 1.
Suan, 57, is currently the managing director of Orient Overseas Developments Ltd (OODL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the group, OOIL said in a statement.
OODL is the holding company for the group's investments in China, it said.
The statement also said OOIL had accepted the retirement of S.D. Lu and M.H. Liang, both 69, as directors of the group effective on May 1.
